title: GTIN product Markdown output
description: One dataset row per GTIN, plus REPORT.md, PRODUCTS.md, CHUNKS.jsonl (optional), SUMMARY and OUTPUT in the default key-value store.

results.title: Product results
results.description: Dataset rows: gtin, source, title, brand, size, category, images, description, ingredients, nutrition, asin, url, errorClass, hint.

reportMarkdown.title: Markdown report (REPORT.md)
reportMarkdown.description: Summary counts + one product card per successful GTIN.

productsMarkdown.title: Products Markdown (PRODUCTS.md)
productsMarkdown.description: Concatenated product cards only (no summary table).

chunks.title: RAG chunks (CHUNKS.jsonl)
chunks.description: Newline-delimited JSON chunks (~500–800 chars) when includeRagChunks is true.

summary.title: Run summary (SUMMARY)
summary.description: ok, failed, bySource, byClass, charged, durationSecs, peakMemoryMb.
